entries.en: Added Enter key to accept and submit prompt suggestions immediately (tab still accepts for editing)
entries.zh: 添加回车键以立即接受并提交提示建议（选项卡仍接受编辑）

entries.en: Added wildcard syntax `mcp__server__*` for MCP tool permissions to allow or deny all tools from a server
entries.zh: 为 MCP 工具权限添加了通配符语法`mcp__server__*`，以允许或拒绝来自服务器的所有工具

entries.en: Added auto-update toggle for plugin marketplaces, allowing per-marketplace control over automatic updates
entries.zh: 为插件市场添加了自动更新切换，允许每个市场控制自动更新

entries.en: Added `current_usage` field to status line input, enabling accurate context window percentage calculations
entries.zh: 在状态行输入中添加了`current_usage`字段，以实现准确的上下文窗口百分比计算

entries.en: Improved memory usage by 3x for large conversations
entries.zh: 改进大型对话的内存占用，降低为原来的三分之一

entries.en: Improved resolution of stats screenshots copied to clipboard (Ctrl+S) for crisper images
entries.zh: 改进用 Ctrl+S 复制到剪贴板的统计截图清晰度

entries.en: Improve UI for file creation permission dialog
entries.zh: 改进文件创建权限对话框的界面

entries.en: Fixed input being cleared when processing queued commands while the user was typing
entries.zh: 修复了用户键入时处理排队命令时输入被清除的问题

entries.en: Fixed prompt suggestions replacing typed input when pressing Tab
entries.zh: 修复了按 Tab 时替换键入输入的提示建议

entries.en: Fixed diff view not updating when terminal is resized
entries.zh: 修复了调整终端大小时差异视图不更新的问题

entries.en: Fix thinking mode toggle in /config not persisting correctly
entries.zh: 修复 /config 中的思维模式切换未正确持续的问题

entries.en: Removed # shortcut for quick memory entry (tell Claude to edit your CLAUDE.md instead)
entries.zh: 移除用 `#` 快速添加记忆的快捷方式（请让 Claude 直接编辑你的 CLAUDE.md）
